items.title: Show HN: Acceptodds a Prediction Market for Research
items.contentSnippet:
I built acceptodds.com a prediction market for research paper. Think polymarket but not with real money.
It now has several markets including ICLR 2027 acceptance, Neurips 2026 papers and OpenAI Math results and over 2k registered traders.
It's an experiment and the hope would be to get a better signal of paper quality than the current review system which is under heavy strain due to AI submissions.

items.title: Show HN: 4B VLM trained on 600k questions to query images in one pass
items.contentSnippet:
Heyo!
I'm Adit, an undergrad in Finland. This is a preview of a side project I worked on last weekend. Essentially, Dragonfly is a LoRA fine-tune of Qwen3-VL with typed output heads that answers many questions about an image in one pass, with a probability for every answer. Unlike a VLM that generates an answer to each question, Dragonfly reads the image once and scores every question in the same pass. Questions can't see each other, so each answer is the same as asking it alone, in any order.
